group_key: near-duplicate group: exact content-hash groups merged with word-8-shingle Jaccard >= 0.8 groups (inverted-index candidates). The `source` field is NOT a document id (human rows share dataset URLs), so it cannot group documents; content identity is the grouping key.
partition_rule: bucket = int(sha256(group_key), 16) % 10; buckets 0-2 fit, 3-4 dev/selection, 5-9 final-test. Group assignment uses row identity only, never a detector score. The final-test set influenced no threshold, calibration, or selection decision (none was made; native operating point).
